units.source_text: 这天的晨空，飘浮着灿烂的朝霞残片。

en.t: In the morning sky that day, brilliant remnants of the dawn glow were drifting.

units.source_text: 蔚蓝的天空移动者还映得通红的浮云。

en.t: Across the deep blue sky moved floating clouds still flushed bright red by the light.

units.source_text: 云朵仿佛还没有从羞怯中清醒过来。

en.t: The clouds seemed not yet to have awakened from their shyness.
